question: Should CodexBar include an opt-in ZoomMate provider that reads a user-authorized Chrome session and tracks a general enterprise AI-agent credit pool, despite ZoomMate not being a conventional coding-provider subscription?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded, but whether this provider belongs in the product and should carry ongoing endpoint/session maintenance is a repository-owner decision rather than a mechanical code-review question.

options.title: Sponsor the core provider
options.body: Approve the disabled-by-default provider after a current-main validation refresh and the small release-owned changelog cleanup.

options.title: Keep it outside the app
options.body: Decline the core integration because the product is outside CodexBar's intended provider scope, while preserving the linked proposal as the rationale.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Ask for a reduced provider surface or a documented auth boundary before deciding whether to sponsor it.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core provider
recommendation.body: Approve the disabled-by-default provider after a current-main validation refresh and the small release-owned changelog cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-level product scope and support-boundary acceptance require the project owner's judgment.
